assignment_rules.Binding: source_workset_id is the member_id of an added WorkflowMember row
assignment_rules.Failure: context.run_id, and discovery_id must equal that invocation's discovery_id (not in the brief's list)
assignment_rules.QueueTicket: owner_id is execution_id:attempt_id:uuid; the first two parts match the context of an added Attempt or TransportAttempt row
assignment_rules.Source: the earliest invocation whose parent workset lists source.source_id
assignment_rules.WorkflowAttempt: context.run_id; the two rows are numbered by context.started_at and must equal F1
assignment_rules.WorkflowChildExecution: call_ref equals checked.call_ref() of an added WorkflowChildCall row
assignment_rules.WorkflowMember: parent_ref equals the parent workset of the invocation's DiscoverySession
